claims: Vic Schaefer is the head women's basketball coach at the University of Texas at Austin.
Vic Schaefer has led the Longhorns since 2020.
Under Vic Schaefer's leadership, the Longhorns have made multiple Elite Eight appearances.
Under Vic Schaefer's leadership, the Longhorns returned to the Final Four in 2026.
Vic Schaefer's position is Head Coach at University of Texas.
Vic Schaefer is a two-time National Coach of the Year.
Vic Schaefer is a four-time SEC Coach of the Year.
Vic Schaefer was head coach at Mississippi State from 2012–2020.
Vic Schaefer was head coach at Sam Houston State from 1990–1997.
